blocks.text: Co-dominance aisi virasat hai jis mein gene jore ke dono alleles heterozygote mein poori tarah zahir hote hain, baghair milawat aur baghair aik ke doosre ko chhupaye, is liye dono alleles ki paidawar us ke phenotype mein saath saath nazar aati hai.

Insani MN blood group co-dominance dikhata hai. Is ke do alleles hain: LM, jo M antigen banata hai, aur LN, jo N antigen banata hai. Jab dono maujood hon to red blood cells par dono antigens hote hain.

blocks.alt: Baen panel: surkh four-o'clock phool RR ko safaid WW se milane par gulabi RW phool; RW x RW ka 2 x 2 Punnett square RR, RW, RW aur WW deta hai, likha hai F2: 1 surkh : 2 gulabi : 1 safaid. Daen panel: teen red blood cells, pehle par sirf chokor M antigens (LM LM, M group), doosre par sirf tikoni N antigens (LN LN, N group) aur teesre par dono (LM LN, MN group).
blocks.caption: Daen taraf MN cells co-dominance dikhate hain (Figure 18.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Incomplete dominance mein koi allele doosre ko nahi chhupata, is liye heterozygote darmiyani hota hai: surkh RR x safaid WW four-o'clock se sab gulabi RW, aur RW x RW se surkh, gulabi aur safaid 1:2:1 mein, jo genotype ki nisbat (ratio) jaisa hai. Co-dominance mein dono alleles poori tarah saath saath zahir hote hain: MN blood group mein allele LM M antigen aur LN N antigen banata hai, aur LM LN shakhs ke red cells par dono antigens hote hain, baghair kisi milawat ke.

blocks.caption: Incomplete dominance aur co-dominance ka muqabla

Heterozygote aik hi waqt mein dono walidain ke phenotypes dikhata hai.
Misaal: Japani four-o'clock paude mein phool ka rang.
Misalein: insani MN blood group aur insani AB blood group.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: 'L' Landsteiner aur Levine ke liye hai jinhon ne yeh nizam 1927 mein daryaft kiya. Ise MNS system bhi kehte hain kyunke MN group aur S/s group ke genes aik hi chromosome par linked hain.

blocks.prompt: Mard LM LN aur biwi LN LN hai. Bachchon ke kaun se blood groups aur kis nisbat mein ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Baap LM ya LN deta, maa sirf LN: bachche LM LN (MN group) ya LN LN (N group), 1:1.

items: Co-dominance: dono alleles poore zahir (LM LN par M aur N).
Incomplete dominance milata hai; co-dominance dono dikhata hai.
